text:
tereza: Quick: need to lock Optimize toolkit scope for next sprint. Two customer asks: eval-triggered regressions + small mobile batching helper. Proposing minimal slice: alert infra + PD hook + 3 templates, and a tiny JS/Kotlin batching snippet. Defer quant recs. Agree?

mike: Agree to keep it tight. One item: include "quiet hours" for PD delivery per tenant.

anil: ML agrees on eval-deltas first. I'll provide concordance_delta, auc_drop, and failure_rate templates. Rule sketch: if baseline - current > 0.05 and n>=30 -> alert.

sara: Infra: need per-tenant buckets, durable alert queue, webhook tester, canary toggle. ETA ~3w for infra if UI/ML freeze.

mike: UI: simple template picker + threshold + tenant toggle. Inbox to show sample prompts. I'll prototype two screens. Need an API: /alerts/eval-diff?tenant=..

tereza: Acceptance gates: alerts fire on internal eval suite; PD + Console validated for 2 betas; batching snippets + docs; beta runbook + oncall. Target beta ~5w.

anil: Will freeze templates EOW and add small eval pack.

sara: I'll add canary flag and webhook test endpoint this sprint.

mike: I'll post mocks by Wed.

ops-bot: Event created: "Optimize toolkit scope freeze"  2025-04-15 10:00 PT. Invitees: tereza, mike, anil, sara.

tereza: Thanks. Call out scope creep now (quant recs or full rule-builder) or we'll defer. :rocket:
